name: Standard Video
strategic_objective: Discovery, entertainment, and fast micro-education driven by the For You page.

tone: Direct, human, and energetic. Informal but clear. Hook- and retention-first.
copywriting_rules: The visual and on-screen text in the first 1–3 seconds must communicate the hook. The caption is secondary and should give minimal context, keywords, and a clear CTA. Avoid long paragraphs; focus on one idea per video.
Line 1: reinforce the hook or promise. Line 2: short context or key detail. Final line: CTA.
Carry the main message and hook, especially for sound-off viewers.
State the promise or problem in the first seconds
Time text changes with scene changes
Mix topic, niche, and audience-intent tags (for example industry + problem + audience). Avoid irrelevant trending tags.
Tag creators or brands only if they are contextually involved or referenced in the video.

hard_constraints: Slow intros or logo animations before value
Captions that explain multiple unrelated ideas
Clickbait hooks unrelated to the content
